description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'CloudCode' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Server-side scripting (CloudCode): the active JavaScript revision the title runs, plus execution policy — engine limits, rate limits, per-handler metadata, whether logs/stack traces are revealed to clients. Scripts are the ONLY way to write protected player data (UserCustomData ReadOnly/Internal buckets) and mutable title data (TitleCustomData Runtime scope). Prefer the dedicated cloud-code tools over editing this section by hand: they compute the code hash, bump the revision number and archive the previous one.

CloudCodeHttpPolicy.description: Outbound HTTP policy for CloudCode scripts. Disabled by default; requests are only allowed to explicitly listed hosts.

AllowInsecureHttp.description: Allow plain http:// in addition to https://. False by default: a substituted secret would travel in clear text.

AllowedHosts.description: Allowed hosts: exact match (api.stripe.com) or subdomain wildcard (*.stripe.com). An empty list means nothing is allowed — there is deliberately no allow-all mode.

Enabled.description: Master switch. When false, server.HttpRequest is rejected outright.

MaxRequestsPerExecution.description: How many outbound requests one execution may make. 0 means the default (3).

MaxResponseBytes.description: Response size cap in bytes. 0 means the default (65536). A larger body is dropped and flagged instead of truncated silently.

TimeoutMilliseconds.description: Per-request timeout in ms. 0 means the default (5000). Clamped server-side so the call fits inside the 10-second execution budget.

CloudCodeResourceCapRule.description: One CloudCode resource-grant cap. See CloudCodeResourcePolicy.Caps.

PerPlayerDaily.description: Per-player daily cap. null = no cap on this axis.

TitleDaily.description: Title-wide daily cap. null = no cap on this axis.

CloudCodeResourcePolicy.description: The script's right to move player resources and start InApp AI. Enabled=false (default): both methods refuse outright, before any other field is read. Crypto under THIS policy is only the first gate ('the script may touch crypto at all'); the actual safety of a crypto grant (caps, pool backing) is CryptoCurrencyDefinition.ServerGrantPolicy of EACH currency, and always applies regardless of this policy.

AllowEventTokens.description: Allow the script to move event tokens (ResourceBundle.EventTokens) — leaderboard scores, event tokens.

AllowedConsumeTypes.description: Resource types the script may CONSUME from the player. null/empty = default (VirtualCurrency, Item). Consuming does not mint value, so this list is intentionally less strict than the grant one, but Purchase is forbidden just the same.

AllowedGrantTypes.description: Resource types the script may GRANT. null/empty = default (VirtualCurrency, Item). CryptoCurrency and RewardedVideoCredit require explicit listing. Purchase is ALWAYS forbidden (not a storable resource — the player's store money, the script cannot control it).

Caps.description: Grant caps by resource key: "VirtualCurrency:{CurrencyID}", "Item:{CatalogID}:{ItemID}", "RewardedVideoCredit". No key = no cap.

Enabled.description: Master switch. false: server.ApplyResourceOperation and server.StartAIGeneration are refused outright.

CloudCodeSchedule.description: A handler run on a schedule.

Args.description: Optional JSON passed to the handler as args.Args (up to 8 KB).

Enabled.description: null or true = enabled; false = paused.

Handler.description: Handler name in the active revision (handlers.<name>).

ID.description: Schedule id (letters, digits, '_' up to 64 chars).

StartAtUtc.description: Anchor time in UTC: runs happen at StartAtUtc + k × IntervalMinutes. null = aligned to 00:00 UTC (60 = on the hour, 1440 = at midnight UTC).

Enabled.description: null or true = enabled; false = requests are refused.

Handler.description: Handler name in the active revision (handlers.<name>).

Header.description: Header with the signature or token. null = X-Signature (HmacSha256) or X-Webhook-Token (Token).

ID.description: Webhook id — the last segment of its URL (letters, digits, '_' up to 64 chars).

SecretName.description: Name of a title secret (kind Secret) used to verify requests. The value never reaches the script.

x-enum-descriptions: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the secret, hex (optionally 'sha256=' prefixed), in Header (default X-Signature).
The secret itself in Header (default X-Webhook-Token).
Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

Payment in Credits, the PLATFORM currency on the player's iDos Games account (players see it as "Aspis" — write Aspis in player-facing text). Requires only Amount — the price in whole Credits. Like Purchase it is NOT a player resource and never enters ResourceService: it is settled by PlatformCreditsPayment in the same transaction as the grant (buyer charged, author credited). Accepted only by the store (Store.Purchase) for now; allowed only in Consume.

value.description: New value for the CloudCode field.

ResourcePolicy.description: The script's right to move player resources and start InApp AI. Enabled=false (default): server.ApplyResourceOperation and server.StartAIGeneration refuse outright.

Schedules.description: Handlers run on a schedule: every IntervalMinutes from StartAtUtc, with args = { Trigger: 'Schedule', ScheduleID, ScheduledAtUtc, Args }. At most 20 schedules; the most frequent is every 5 minutes. Runs as the server (no player session); one run per slot, missed slots are not replayed.

Webhooks.description: Incoming webhooks: POST https://api.idosgames.com/api/v2/{titleID}/Public/CloudCode/Webhook/{id} runs a handler for an external service (payments, site forms, bots) with args = { Trigger: 'Webhook', WebhookID, Headers, Query, Body }. The request is verified BEFORE the handler runs — HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with a title secret, or the secret itself as a token header. The handler's result is the HTTP response.
